hooks.note: Native FUN_00014ae0+0xc, after null and lifecycle guards and before push {r4,r5,lr}; sub sp,#0x4c. At this point r0 still holds descriptor, LR/SP unchanged. The entire 0x14ae0..0x14bc8 launcher is identical in both firmware. Only the exact BD path and non-debug launch use the replacement fork+execve branch. Descriptor slots: 2 debug selector string, 3 executable path, 4 argv, 6 child PID, 7 lifecycle. All other launches delegate the original trampoline.

bindings.note: Runtime debug selector string compared by the original launcher, not a guessed literal.

lifecycle: Long-lived media manager; install before the next disc launch. It does not alter an already-running apl_bdv.
